name: Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report
summary: Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report carries his latest findings from Gadgetzan to leaders in Darnassus or Orgrimmar. He hopes they will heed the silithid threat and help confront it.

sections.title: A Report from Gadgetzan
sections.body: In Gadgetzan, Pestlezugg sends his latest findings about the silithid to someone who can reach the leaders. The report travels to Gracina Spiritmight at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, or to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar. Pestlezugg believes the danger is too great for Gadgetzan to face alone.

sections.title: Heeding the Warning
sections.body: Gracina and Zilzibin both fear that hatred between the Alliance and Horde blinds their leaders to the silithid threat. Gracina says the Alliance dismisses dangers that do not come from the Horde, while the Horde's leaders are divided by conflicting advice. Both recipients urge continued effort against the silithid.

faq.answer: Pestlezugg, who works in Gadgetzan, wrote the report about his latest findings on the silithid.
The report carries Pestlezugg's latest findings on the silithid threat.
The report is carried to Gracina Spiritmight at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, or to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.
Pestlezugg believes Gadgetzan cannot face the silithid threat alone and hopes leaders can act on his findings.

faq.q: What does Gracina think of the warning?
faq.answer: Gracina says the Alliance overlooks threats that do not come from the Horde, and she urges continued effort against the silithid.
Zilzibin says the Horde is distracted by conflicting advice, though he believes Thrall might act if the facts reached him.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you carry Pestlezugg's warning to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus, where she hopes her leaders will take the silithid threat seriously.
As a Horde traveler, you bring Pestlezugg's warning to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar, in the hope that Thrall may hear the facts.
